name: io.gamedock.sdk.ads.internal.GamedockAdsAdActivity
description: When the older Gamedock (Azerion) Android SDK starts a Gamedock interstitial or rewarded video, this Activity provides its full-screen loading, cancel, and ad-display flow.
disableEffect: Blocking it stops these Gamedock ads; users will not receive rewards for rewarded videos handled by this flow.
